# Absolutistic Pantheism Keeps No Connexion with Concreteness

But,[^1] the brand of pantheism offered is hard for them to assimilate if they are lovers of facts, or empirically minded.[^2] It is the absolutistic brand, spurning the dust and reared upon pure logic.[^3] It keeps no connexion whatever with concreteness.[^4] Affirming the Absolute Mind, which is its substitute for God, to be the rational presupposition of all particulars of fact, whatever they may be, it remains supremely indifferent to what the particular facts in our world actually are.[^5] Be they what they may, the Absolute will father them.[^6] You cannot redescend into the world of particulars by the Absolute's aid, or deduce any necessary consequences of detail important for your life from your idea of his nature.[^7] He gives you indeed the assurance that all is well with Him, and for his eternal way of thinking; but thereupon he leaves you to be finitely saved by your own temporal devices.[^8]

[^4]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "It keeps no connexion whatever with concreteness."
[^5]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "Affirming the Absolute Mind, which is its substitute for God, to be the rational presupposition of all particulars of fact, whatever they may be, it remains supremely indifferent to what the particular facts in our world actually are."
[^6]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "Be they what they may, the Absolute will father them."
